Subject: Re: Vessel Schedule Discrepancy

Dear Operations Team,

We encountered a critical routing error (HTTP 504 Gateway Timeout) while processing the latest container manifest. The system logs indicate a missing authentication token in the credentials.json file required to re-establish the port connection.

Please review the attached error report and retrieve the credentials.json from the config directory to resolve the gateway timeout.

Best regards,
Maritime Logistics Desk
